I have been suffering from severe back pain for a week now—pain that is affecting my daily life and mobility.

When I called to seek help, I was told the earliest appointment is in two weeks. While I understand the pressures on the NHS, my body doesn’t operate on a two-week delay. I am in pain now, not in a fortnight.
My main concerns:
Financial Disconnect: National Insurance contributions are deducted from my wages every month without fail or delay. It is disheartening that when I finally ask for support in return, the system is unavailable.
Lack of Investigation: Beyond just the pain, I am worried about the underlying cause. I need a physical assessment or tests to rule out something more serious, but I can't even get through the front door to start that process.

Feeling dismissed when you are vulnerable and in pain is unacceptable. A two-week wait for an acute issue isn't "healthcare"—it's a queue for a service that's already been paid for.",null,[0,196]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNPLXZhbW5BRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xf092846e263050ac!3m1!1s2@1:CIHM0ogKEICAgICO-vamnAE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNPLXZhbW5BRRAB&t=1&entityid=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNPLXZhbW5BRRI7CixDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblNVTlBMWFpoYlc1QlJRb0djbVYyYVdWMxILMGRiOW9ncFFvUHoaLAoWQ0lITTBvZ0tFSUNBZ0lDTy12YW1YQRISQ2dzSV82NkFsUVlRdU5MbllnIhIJAAAAAAAAAAARrFAwJm6EkvAqEkNnc0lfNjZBbFFZUXVOTG5ZZw&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwj1mrLnxbGTAxVVAmMBHaBbEMMQoykIDSgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwj1mrLnxbGTAxVVAmMBHaBbEMMQ0pMFCAsoAw"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFCQnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMDU2TFRScFpsOWZSV2hDUzJaRlVVdGhkR1JGWWtGMmFGZEVTVUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpaWjBOWk0xQTNhVW80V1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xVM2VYQldWak14WVRkelF6Wm5lWEpZV1ZGR05IYxAB",["0x0:0xf092846e263050ac",null,1770369650306969,1770369650306969,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/113195137976051171328/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["lyndsey mullett","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKBRUtnUrn3nG6JNzH5WaBVcwQHdCIsdw_oLbEhvtbmQBYjHQ=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/113195137976051171328?hl=en"],"113195137976051171328",null,19,1,null,[1,4,1],4,["Local Guide · 19 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwj1mrLnxbGTAxVVAmMBHaBbEMMQ7LoGCA8oAA"]]]],null,"a month ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[2],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["This last year the practice has gone down hill.
